definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese three-stringed musical instrument played with a plectrum, used in various genres of traditional music.

examples.japanese: {三味線|しゃみせん}を{弾|ひ}く。
{津軽|つがる}{三味線|じゃみせん}は{力強|ちからづよ}い。
{歌舞伎|かぶき}には{三味線|しゃみせん}の{伴奏|ばんそう}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Shamisen accompaniment is essential for kabuki.

notes:
COMPOUND: {三|さん/しゃ} (three) + {味|み} (taste) + {線|せん} (string) - though {味|み} refers to 撥味 (plectrum feel)

ALTERNATE READING:
・{三味線|さみせん} - also correct

PARTS:
・{胴|どう} (body - covered with animal skin)
・{棹|さお} (neck)
・{糸|いと} (strings)
・{撥|ばち} (plectrum)

TYPES/STYLES:
・{津軽|つがる}{三味線|じゃみせん} (Tsugaru shamisen - powerful, fast)
・{義太夫|ぎだゆう}{三味線|じゃみせん} (for bunraku/joruri)
・{長唄|ながうた}{三味線|じゃみせん} (for kabuki)
・{地唄|じうた}{三味線|じゃみせん} (chamber music)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{三味線|しゃみせん}を{弾|ひ}く (to play shamisen)
・{三味線|しゃみせん}{奏者|そうしゃ} (shamisen player)
